STUDENT DATA PRIVACY AGREEMENT

This Student Data Privacy Agreement is entered into as of August 3, 2026 between Pinecrest Charter Academy (the "School") and Tallyho Apps LLC (the "Provider").

1. Student Data. The School will give the Provider a roster of its students so that the Provider can set up accounts for its math practice app.

2. Privacy. The Provider takes privacy seriously and will comply with applicable law.

3. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Arizona.
